items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] you also worked with J. J. Johnson? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes before I worked with J.J. I worked with Tyree Glen...

ctx.x: No. I was just trying to play as well as I could with who was there. It depends on who’s there and you can modify whatever you do because you had to compliment the soloist and if you can’t do that you might as well get a drum machine! And it’s really important to listen to what the rest of the group is doing. It’s a niche and you have to find, and get into that groove or niche. Then it’s fun.
you also worked with J. J. Johnson?
Yes before I worked with J.J. I worked with Tyree Glen ad the round table on 52nd street and Lexington, The Embers was around the corner, all of these clubs. That was educational for me cause-­
